lines.text: Ask: Do you have a pen?
Many learners say: Is there a pen with you?
Better: Do you have a pen with you?
Use have to ask what someone owns.
The second! Do you have a pen with you?

data.wrong: Is there a pen with you?
data.right: Do you have a pen with you?
data.why: Use have to ask what someone owns.

en.hook: Do you say “Is there a pen”?
en.tip: In Arabic we say «هل معك قلم؟», but in English we ask with do you have: “Do you have a pen with you?” not “Is there a pen with you?”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “Is there a pen with you?” 😅 In Arabic we say «هل معك قلم؟», but in English we ask with do you have, so the right sentence is “Do you have a pen with you?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
